title: Understanding Ridge vs LASSO
text: Ridge regression and LASSO regression are both regularization techniques used to prevent overfitting. However, they handle coefficients differently. Ridge regression tends to shrink coefficients evenly, while LASSO can shrink some coefficients to zero.

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: Consider how the change from ridge to LASSO might affect the model's ability to fit the data. LASSO can lead to simpler models by setting some coefficients to zero, which might affect bias.

title: Comparing Bias
text: If LASSO sets some coefficients to zero, how does this affect the model's complexity and bias compared to ridge regression?
